# Anything Plays Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

Anything Plays is a free, open-source project intended to make gaming
more accessible, creative, and fun.

We welcome respectful contributions, constructive feedback, bug reports,
and suggestions from everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and considerate of others.
- Provide constructive feedback about code and functionality.
- Respect differing experience levels and development approaches.
- Keep discussions relevant to the project.
- Respect the privacy of contributors and maintainers.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, intimidation, threats, or personal attacks.
- Publishing or threatening to publish private information.
- Discriminatory or hateful language.
- Repeated hostile or deliberately disruptive behavior.
- Targeted harassment of contributors or maintainers.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove inappropriate
contributions where platform permissions allow.

Maintainers may also restrict participation, block users, or report
abusive behavior through GitHub's moderation tools.

Participation in this project requires following this Code of Conduct.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to project-managed spaces, including
issues, pull requests, discussions, and other official community channels.

## Reporting

Report abusive behavior using GitHub's reporting features.

For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md.
